_about: Median vertical offset Canva applies to a PPTX text box, as a fraction of the font size (em). Measured on the PEFA booklet import, 456 boxes, Nov 2026. Negative = Canva sets the text higher, so the builder lowers the box. Keyed 'Canva font name|bold|italic'. Used only until a box is measured (cv.py calibrate).
